about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Discovery Sport D165 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Discovery Sport D165 was introduced in 2020 as part of a diesel range simplification, replacing the previous D150 and D180 badges. It uses the Ingenium AJ200D or AJ150D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel that's been a mainstay of JLR's compact SUV range. It's a Euro 6d-compliant unit, fitted to the L550-generation Discovery Sport, and represents the current diesel offering in the range alongside the higher-output D200.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D engines for every Discovery Sport D165 on the road.

codes.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery Sport D165 ENGINE

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the Discovery Sport D165 from 2020 onwards. It's a common-rail turbo-diesel with a timing chain-driven valvetrain. The Ingenium diesel family is known for timing chain tensioner wear and EGR cooler leaks — which we address as standard on every rebuild.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery Sport D165 ENGINE
compatibility.intro: The D165 is part of a broader Ingenium diesel range, and its compatibility is determined by the L550 generation chassis. Unlike earlier diesel variants, the D165 was introduced with a simplified model range to reduce confusion. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
